purpose: Inventory-only construction of the complete Zaporizhzhia multi-episode-date audit universe. No historical source search, manual episode review, reclassification, canonical repair, dashboard/monitor modification, or deployment is performed.

denominator_construction.rule: Union of the nine frozen canonical Zaporizhzhia denominator source-slice files P1a..P4c on the target branch.

kyiv_calendar_date.rule: Convert each alert_start instant to Europe/Kyiv using the IANA timezone and group by that local calendar date.
kyiv_calendar_date.validation: Computed local dates match alert_start_date_kyiv for all 2365 canonical episodes.

canonical_strict_mapping.rule: Map all 169 strict_events to canonical denominator episodes using matched_episode_id when present; otherwise normalize one of alert_start, alert_episode_start, matched_alert_start, or matched_alert_start_kyiv to an instant and match the unique canonical alert_start instant.

methodology.target_universe: All canonical non-strict episodes whose alert_start Europe/Kyiv calendar date contains at least two canonical denominator episodes.
methodology.group_A: Multi-episode Kyiv dates containing at least one canonical strict episode and at least one canonical non-strict episode.
methodology.group_B: Multi-episode Kyiv dates containing zero canonical strict episodes.

previous_qa_status_assignment.known_confirmed_miss: Episode is a confirmed strict miss in the gap audit or a confirmed strict miss in either blind wave.
previous_qa_status_assignment.known_needs_review: Episode is needs_review in the gap audit or a blind wave.
previous_qa_status_assignment.blind_audited_negative: Episode was sampled in blind Wave 1 or Wave 2 with verdict no_explosion_evidence_found.
previous_qa_status_assignment.gap_audited_negative: Episode has an explicit episode_id in gap audit manual_candidate_register with result=not_strict. Date-only or episode_id=null gap entries are not projected onto individual episodes.
previous_qa_status_assignment.not_previously_audited: None of the four statuses above applies.
previous_qa_status_assignment.multi_label_policy: All applicable labels are preserved in previous_qa_labels. previous_qa_status is the first applicable label under the documented priority.

batching.order: Group A first, then Group B; chronological by Europe/Kyiv alert-start date within group.
batching.date_atomicity: All unreviewed targeted episodes from one Kyiv calendar date stay in the same batch so same-date attribution can be reviewed together.
batching.packing_rule: Sequential date blocks; when adding the next whole date would cross 20, close at whichever boundary is closer to 20 episodes. Never split a date.
